brief:
Russian-Israeli historian Artium Kirpichnikov, 51, disappeared following his arrival in Israel last week, Shehab Wire reported. He landed at Ben Gurion Airport but went missing shortly thereafter. Kirpichnikov has publicly opposed Zionism and Israeli occupation.

The circumstances of his disappearance remain unclear. Multiple reports have confirmed the missing person case, though details about the investigation or his whereabouts have not been disclosed. Authorities have not yet issued statements regarding efforts to locate him or the reasons for his travel to Israel.
